value:
CLI-as-first-class-agent-target is the NEXT-PRIORITY feature (umbrella issue #117, milestone v1.1.0 #8, design docs/design-117-cli-agent-parity.md). CRUCIAL not polish — driven by a real deployment blocker: at least one user's employer prohibits MCP servers outright, so for that cohort the CLI is the ONLY way an AI agent (Claude/Gemini/Copilot/Cursor) can touch Reverie. Directly serves project.goals #4 (agent-agnostic).

KEY INSIGHT: functional parity already exists (all 19 MCP tools have CLI commands). The gap is three MCP PROTOCOL AFFORDANCES the CLI lacks: (1) structured I/O — mutations emit human text, only reads have bare --json with no stable envelope; (2) the handshake — and worse, the only fetchable instructions (DEFAULT_LLM_INSTRUCTIONS in src/llm-instructions.ts) are MCP-only text telling a CLI agent to "PREFER MCP TOOLS" it can't reach (a correctness bug for this cohort); (3) session statefulness — write-amp guard, confirm tokens, miss-path tracking are MCP-only because the server is long-lived and the CLI is per-process.

SCOPE DECIDED 2026-05-27: ALL THREE workstreams land in v1.1.0. WS1 universal JSON envelope (ship FIRST — unblocks the cohort alone). WS2 surface-aware instructions [do the MCP->CLI instructions split first, it's a correctness bug] + AGENTS.md from init + rvr manifest. WS3 RVR_SESSION-bridged guard/telemetry parity (ships LAST — depends on WS1 envelope + shared instrumentation; no longer deferred, the corporate-ban cohort is the signal the gate waited for). Confirm-token flow deliberately NOT ported — replaced by a stateless REQUIRES_CONFIRMATION envelope.

DECIDED: D3 LOCKED — break the existing bare---json read output, unify everything on the envelope. STILL OPEN (decide at WS2 impl time): D7 manifest necessity. Each workstream = its own PR. WS1 CHANGELOG is ### Changed (envelope break) + ### Added (json on mutations).
